name: Restabilization Cog
summary: Outside Gnomeregan's irradiated ruins, leper gnomes still carry Restabilization Cogs. In Kharanos, tinkerers need the intact parts to build the Recombobulator, a machine meant to reverse leper mutation.

sections.title: Components for a Cure
sections.body: Radiation flooded Gnomeregan in a failed attempt to wipe out the invading troggs. Countless gnomes became sick, hostile leper gnomes, driven from their home as exiles. Even in madness, they carry intricate gnomish machinery and fittings that can be salvaged. Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket believe the terrible change can be undone. They need adventurers to recover parts from the afflicted outside Gnomeregan's gates and finish their prototype Recombobulation Device. Intact Restabilization Cogs will balance its inner combustion systems.

faq.q: What is a Restabilization Cog used for?
faq.answer: Tinker Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos needs Restabilization Cogs. Along with Gyromechanic Gears, they are structural pieces for the Recombobulator, an experimental machine meant to cure irradiated leper gnomes.

faq.q: Where can these cogs be found?
faq.answer: Leper gnomes and the deranged Gibblewilt carry these cogs. They roam the exterior gates and trenches outside Gnomeregan in western Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Can the Recombobulator actually cure the leper gnomes?
aliases: is there a cure for leper gnomes
faq.answer: Razzle Sprysprocket and Ozzie Togglevolt believe calibrated machinery can reverse the mutation. Whether the Recombobulator can restore the leper gnomes' minds and bodies remains untested, and the effort to find a cure continues.

angles.text: For an exiled gnome in Dun Morogh, recovering these parts means taking machinery from corrupted kin in the hope of a cure for Gnomeregan's fallen.
As an engineer, you can see how Restabilization Cogs fit gnomish mechanical assemblies like the Recombobulator.
